{{Top}}
'''Metallurgy''' was the science of the behaviors and properties of metals and their extraction from their ores. It studied the processes of producing objects made of metal, including quarrying, mine construction, and smelting. The [[Onderon/Legends|Onderonian]] [[Warb Null|Shas Dovos]], later known as the armored [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] "Warb Null," was a devoted metallurgist.<ref name="totjc">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref>

Raw metals were brought to workshops known as forges, where they were heated and wrought in order to shape things out of them. Primitive '''metalworking''' required the use of [[Fire/Legends|fire]] in a furnace and a hammer to strike the cooling metal.<ref name="totjc" /> On [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], the first members of the [[Je'daii Order]] crafted their [[Sword/Legends|swords]] in the [[Vur Tepe]], a forge located along the mouth of an active volcano.<ref name="DOTJ0">[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|''Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi'' 0]]</ref>

The apparition of simple metalworking was considered one of the necessary achievements to reach the [[Technology level|feudal technology level]].<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> The [[Defel/Legends|Defel]] from [[Af'El/Legends|Af'El]] had developed a high level of technology based on metal&mdash;the were excellent miners and metallurgists, but never developed agriculture. The [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] from [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] were shore dwellers, and while their ancestors quickly developed rudimentary farming, technological advances were slow because of the difficult time they had in extracting metals from the planet's crust, and thus achieve metallurgy.<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref>
